message.content:
Checked: Pgbouncer connection pool has been exhausted, causing worker throughput to drop to 0. Restarting pgbouncer in the prod namespace has cleared the pool immediately, restoring worker throughput.

Summary: The failed-jobs backlog is significant, with 1388 failures and 47 malformed rows. The pgbouncer connection pool was exhausted, causing worker throughput to drop. Restarting pgbouncer cleared the pool and restored throughput.

Recommended next step: Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs and address it to prevent future failures. Also, consider tuning pgbouncer or increasing the connection pool size if the issue persists.

Will now submit the report and findings.
